mapper.select: SELECT rel_path, status, content_hash, chunked_hash, indexed_at, tags FROM kb_document WHERE rel_path LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
SELECT rel_path, status, content_hash, chunked_hash, indexed_at, tags FROM kb_document WHERE status IN ('unindexed', 'failed')
mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO kb_document (rel_path, status) VALUES (#{path}, 'unindexed')
INSERT INTO kb_document (rel_path, status) VALUES (#{path}, 'unindexed') ON CONFLICT(rel_path) DO UPDATE SET status = 'unindexed'
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET status = #{status} WHERE rel_path = #{path}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_document WHERE rel_path LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
